verdict.rationale: Adyen publishes an official GitHub repository of its API definition files in the OpenAPI Specification standard, so a machine-readable spec is downloadable. The probe's 404s on guessed docs-site paths only show the spec isn't hosted there; they don't contradict the GitHub source. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the repo covers the in-person Terminal API and Management API specifically, a documented download location from the POS docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the spec's completeness.
